newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Empresas ICA started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Empresas ICA started as buy.

text.p: -- Grupo Financiero Serfin started coverage of Mexican builder Empresas ICA with a buy rating.

-- Analyst Gerardo Saenz said he estimated 1996 earnings per share of 3.78 pesos and 1997 earnings per share of 8.60 pesos. He said ICA's 1996 revenues could rise to 8.598 billion pesos, up 49 percent in nominal terms versus 1995 revenues.
-- Saenz said ICA could win the rights to private infrastructure projects worth 4.9 billion pesos during 1997, roughly 15 percent of the total market for infrastructure projects.
-- He said the company's margins should improve as sales improve. He set a 1997 target price for the share of 175 pesos.
-- ICA was unchanged in early trade on the Mexican bourse at 113.80 pesos per share.
